items.prompt:
Read the story.

When the younger campers were scared of the dark, Talia handed out flashlights, told a funny story, and stayed up until every one of them fell asleep.

Which word best describes Talia?
A) Selfish
B) Caring
C) Lazy
D) Rude

steps: Talia helps the scared campers with flashlights and a story.
She stays up until they all fall asleep.
These actions show she is caring, choice B.

items.prompt:
Read the story.

The old cabin stood deep in the pine woods. Snow piled against the door, smoke curled from the chimney, and a warm orange light glowed in the single window.

Which phrase best describes the setting?
A) A busy city street
B) A warm cabin in the snowy woods
C) A sunny beach
D) A crowded classroom
items.answer: B) A warm cabin in the snowy woods

steps: The story names pine woods, snow, and a cabin.
Smoke and warm light show it is cozy inside.
So the setting is a warm cabin in snowy woods, choice B.
solution.answer: B) A warm cabin in the snowy woods

items.prompt:
Read the story.

During the race, Marcus tripped and fell. He got up, brushed the dirt off his knees, and kept running all the way to the finish line even though he came in last.

What does Marcus's action of finishing the race show about him?
A) He is a fast runner
B) He does not give up
C) He does not like running
D) He is angry
items.answer: B) He does not give up

steps: Marcus falls but gets back up.
He finishes the race even though he is last.
This shows he does not give up, choice B.
solution.answer: B) He does not give up

items.prompt:
Read the story.

Whenever the class needed a volunteer for a messy or boring job, Nadia raised her hand before anyone else. She cleaned the paint trays, carried the heavy recycling, and never once complained or asked for thanks.

Which detail best supports the idea that Nadia is helpful and humble?
A) She is in the class
B) She raises her hand for messy jobs and never asks for thanks
C) The paint trays were dirty
D) The recycling was heavy
items.answer: B) She raises her hand for messy jobs and never asks for thanks

steps: The question asks which detail shows she is helpful and humble.
Nadia volunteers for hard jobs and "never once complained or asked for thanks."
That detail shows both helpfulness and humility, choice B.
solution.answer: B) She raises her hand for messy jobs and never asks for thanks

items.prompt:
Read the story.

The museum after closing was silent and enormous. Moonlight fell through the tall glass roof onto the dinosaur bones, and Ana's footsteps echoed down the empty marble halls. Every shadow seemed to stretch and move.

How does the setting most likely make Ana feel?
A) Sleepy and bored
B) A little nervous and amazed
C) Hungry
D) Cheerful and loud
items.answer: B) A little nervous and amazed

steps: The setting is a silent, huge, moonlit museum with moving shadows.
Echoing footsteps and stretching shadows feel eerie, while the moonlit dinosaur bones feel amazing.
So Ana most likely feels nervous and amazed, choice B.
solution.answer: B) A little nervous and amazed

items.prompt:
Read the story.

At first Diego refused to let anyone else touch the group's poster, redoing every part himself and snapping when others offered ideas. But when he saw his teammates sitting quietly with nothing to do, he paused, handed them each a marker, and said, "Show me what you would add."

How does Diego change during the story?
A) He goes from friendly to angry
B) He goes from controlling to willing to share the work
C) He stays exactly the same
D) He gives up on the poster
items.answer: B) He goes from controlling to willing to share the work

steps: At first Diego does everything himself and snaps at others.
Then he hands out markers and asks for their ideas.
So he changes from controlling to sharing, choice B.
solution.answer: B) He goes from controlling to willing to share the work

items.prompt:
Read the story.

Captain Reyes had sailed these waters for thirty years and knew every reef by heart. When the young sailors wanted to race through the narrow channel to save time, she shook her head. "The sea does not reward those who hurry," she said, guiding the ship slowly and safely through. That night, another crew that had raced the channel radioed for help, stuck on the rocks.

Which statement best describes Captain Reyes, based on the whole story?
A) She is careless and lucky
B) She is experienced and wisely cautious
C) She is afraid of the sea
D) She does not know the waters well
items.answer: B) She is experienced and wisely cautious

steps: Reyes has sailed "thirty years" and knows every reef.
She refuses to rush and guides the ship safely, saying the sea does not reward hurrying.
The other crew that raced gets stuck, proving her caution wise, choice B.
solution.answer: B) She is experienced and wisely cautious

items.prompt:
Read the story.

The town square had always been the heart of the village, but after the factory opened, it emptied. Shops closed, the fountain went dry, and weeds pushed up between the cobblestones. Then old Mrs. Fenn began setting out a table of free bread each morning. Slowly, people returned to talk and linger, and within a year the square was full of music and laughter again.

How does the setting change, and what causes the change?
A) The square stays empty the whole story
B) The square goes from lively to empty and back to lively, and Mrs. Fenn's free bread brings people back
C) The factory makes the square more crowded
D) The weeds turn into flowers on their own
items.answer: B) The square goes from lively to empty and back to lively, and Mrs. Fenn's free bread brings people back

steps: The square was the lively heart of town, then emptied after the factory opened.
Mrs. Fenn sets out free bread and people slowly return.
Within a year it is full of life again, so choice B describes the change and its cause.
solution.answer: B) The square goes from lively to empty and back to lively, and Mrs. Fenn's free bread brings people back
